description.summary: what Lumen did, for its contract tests

protocol.description:
The contract tests (tests/contract) read back what the window manager did. On X11 that is what it publishes for pagers (EWMH); this protocol publishes the same on Wayland, and takes the requests a pager sends.
Lumen offers it only when LUMEN_TEST_PROTOCOL is set in its environment. It is not stable and not meant for anything else.

request.name: refresh
request.description: Lumen answers with screen, workarea, desktops, focus and popups, then each managed window of this client (window, frame, client), bottom first, and done.

event.name: focus

description.summary: whether a client has the focus

event.description: nothing is 1 when no client has the focus and the keys go to the window manager.

event.name: popups

description.summary: what the window manager shows by itself

event.description: Its menus, popups, panels and such that are on screen.

event.name: window

description.summary: a managed window of this client

event.description: desktop is -1 for every desktop; stack is its place among the managed windows, 0 at the bottom. frame and client follow.

description.summary: the last window's frame, decorations and all

request.name: set_state

description.summary: change one state, as a pager

request.description: state is one of maximized, fullscreen, iconic and above.

description.summary: the window asks to go below the others
a pager moves and resizes its frame
the window asks to be moved with the keys
send it to a desktop; -1 for all of them
